paper.title: Assessing the genome-wide effect of promoter region tandem repeat natural variation on gene expression
paper.authors: Elmore MH, Gibbons JG, Rokas A.
paper.association_evidence: Data availability: 'SRX202391 - SRX202398 (A. oryzae RNAseq)'; these are the experiment accessions of this BioProject's A. oryzae runs, and the BioProject abstract is the paper's abstract.

study_summary.objective: Test whether natural variation in promoter-region tandem repeats (microsatellites and minisatellites) changes the expression of the downstream genes in A. flavus and its domesticated form A. oryzae.
study_summary.experimental_design: Eight A. oryzae and eight A. flavus isolates were grown from spores on PDA covered with cellophane at 30 C for 24 h, one RNA-seq library each (HiSeq 2000); 143 promoter repeats were tested, and 7 of the 8 A. oryzae isolates are in the atlas.
study_summary.main_finding: Only 4.3% of the repeat-expression relationships tested were significant, fitting repeats acting as tuning, volume or optimality knobs rather than switches, and genes differing between the two species showed no repeat enrichment.

pda_cellophane_24h.note: PDA covered with sterile porous cellophane
potato infusion is an undefined component

notes: One library per isolate, so strain and replicate are not separable; this is a strain-diversity dataset rather than a treatment comparison.
RIB537 (SRX202396, run SRR610546) belongs to the same experiment set but was excluded earlier because its BioSample has an empty species field; the paper lists RIB 537 as an A. oryzae isolate.
